examples.en: The police caught the two thieves.
examples.zh: 警察抓住了那两个小偷。

examples.en: Stop thief!
examples.zh: 捉贼！

examples.en: He became a bus driver.
examples.zh: 他成了一名公共汽车司机。

examples.en: My father is a taxi driver.
examples.zh: 我父亲是出租车司机。

examples.en: He has not regretted his new job.
examples.zh: 他对新工作并不后悔。

examples.en: I regret telling him the truth.
examples.zh: 我后悔把真相告诉了他。

words.meaning: adj. 令人兴奋的，有趣的

examples.en: His new work is far more exciting.
examples.zh: 他的新工作有意思得多。

examples.en: It was an exciting football match.
examples.zh: 那是一场激动人心的足球赛。

examples.en: Two thieves rushed out of a shop.
examples.zh: 两个小偷从商店里冲了出来。

examples.en: The children rushed into the room.
examples.zh: 孩子们冲进了房间。

examples.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
examples.zh: 其中一人提着一只装满钱的手提包。

examples.en: Let me carry the box for you.
examples.zh: 让我帮你搬这个箱子。

examples.en: The thief got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
examples.zh: 小偷吓得把包都扔了。

examples.en: She gave me a fright.
examples.zh: 她吓了我一跳。

examples.en: He dropped the bag and ran away.
examples.zh: 他扔下包逃跑了。

examples.en: Be careful not to drop the glass.
examples.zh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉在地上。

examples.en: Roy drove the bus straight at the thieves.
examples.zh: 罗伊开车径直向小偷撞去。

examples.en: Go straight along this road.
examples.zh: 沿着这条路一直走。

examples.en: Both men were arrested.
examples.zh: 两个人都被逮捕了。

examples.en: The police arrested the thief.
examples.zh: 警察逮捕了那个小偷。

examples.en: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
examples.zh: 罗伊停下车，给警察局打了电话。

examples.en: I will telephone you this evening.
examples.zh: 我今晚给你打电话。

examples.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car.
examples.zh: 不一会儿，警察拦住了那辆车。

examples.en: We had dinner and went home afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后就回家了。

examples.en: A short while ago, he became a bus driver.
examples.zh: 不久前，他成了一名公共汽车司机。

examples.en: I haven't seen him for a long while.
examples.zh: 我很久没见到他了。

examples.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
examples.zh: 罗伊·特伦顿过去开出租车。

examples.en: Roy Trenton is now a bus driver.
examples.zh: 罗伊·特伦顿现在是一名公共汽车司机。

examples.en: He was driving along Catford Street.
examples.zh: 他当时正开车行驶在卡特福德街上。

examples.en: The shop is in Catford Street.
examples.zh: 那家商店在卡特福德街上。

examples.en: The thief was carrying a bag full of money.
examples.zh: 小偷提着一只装满钱的手提包。

examples.en: She put the books in her bag.
examples.zh: 她把书放进包里。

sentences.en: A short while ago, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
sentences.zh: 不久前，他改开公共汽车，但他并不后悔。

sentences.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
sentences.zh: 其中一人提着一只装满钱的手提包。

sentences.en: Roy drove the bus straight at the thieves.
sentences.zh: 罗伊开车径直向小偷撞去。

sentences.en: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
sentences.zh: 罗伊停下车，给警察局打了电话。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
sentences.zh: 不一会儿，警察拦住了那辆车，两个人都被逮捕了。

article.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
article.zh: 罗伊·特伦顿过去开出租车。

article.en: A short while ago, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
article.zh: 不久前，他改开公共汽车，但他并不后悔。

article.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
article.zh: 他觉得新工作有意思得多。

article.en: Recently he was driving along Catford Street when he saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
article.zh: 最近，他开车行驶在卡特福德街上，忽然看见两个小偷从一家商店里冲出来。

article.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
article.zh: 其中一人提着一只装满钱的手提包。

article.en: Roy drove the bus straight at the thieves.
article.zh: 罗伊开车径直向小偷撞去。

article.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
article.zh: 拿钱的那个小偷吓得把包都扔了。

article.en: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
article.zh: 罗伊停下车，给警察局打了电话。

article.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
article.zh: 不一会儿，警察拦住了那辆车，两个人都被逮捕了。
